Name: Albjerk Bil AS
Company description: Albjerk Bil ble grunnlagt i 1973, den gang under navnet Albjerk Auto, og består av bilselskapene Albjerk Bil Drammen, Albjerk Bil Lier, Albjerk Bil Ringerike, Albjerk Bilutleie og Albjerk Bil Outlet. Our system requires only a power outlet and internet access to operate, making it easy to install and use. Its compact size enables it to fit in any tight space, making it an adaptable solution for car rental companies of all sizes. Contact us to learn more!
